title: Does Humidity Raise Blood Pressure? What Adults 35+ Should Know
description: Yes—studies show systolic BP can rise up to 8 mmHg in high-humidity heat. Learn how to monitor and protect your heart this summer.
reasoning: This query is trending due to early-summer heatwaves across the US and Europe, triggering real-time concern among adults 35+ with hypertension or family history; users want actionable, age-specific guidance—not clinical theory—but practical steps to interpret spikes and adjust daily routines safely.
